basis: Existing admitted wire transaction; additional fixed receipt reserve unchanged from R1/R2
native_layout_source: Actual --nocapture Rust test outputs, not inferred WASM layout
compile_time_guards: alignment <= 2*usize and 2*(size_of(PickReceipt)+4*usize) <= 1024; checked separately by each target build
admission_order: WireSession::execute -> admit -> owner state charge -> candidate -> apply/operate stamp check -> Arc::new -> mutation; typed Leave allocates before clearing hover
retention: At most old/new distinct engine-owned receipts in a wire transaction. Outcome, candidate and retry copies share each Arc. Existing per-row/text/cache envelopes retain all encoding/copy reserves.
lifetime_probe: Weak reference observes strong counts 2/4/1 and loss of upgrade on replacement. The Weak keeps the old control block allocated until the probe drops; data release is not a claim that the probe control block was already freed.
measurement_limit: No allocator instrumentation or measured RSS. Logical allocation/accounting and source-order proof plus real retry/stale/budget-refusal state/cache comparisons. Other existing decode/ref/outcome Vec allocations retain their old accounting.
